row:
Hi, my name is Brittany. I am a licensed massage therapist, certified canine massage therapist, and reiki master. My goal is to help animals as well as their human companions feel their best on all levels; physical, mental, emotional, and spiritual by providing holistic services and products that provide healing and promote overall health and well-being. 
I am new to YouTube but would love to share more reiki healing and massage therapy videos with you in the future.
